seed_provenance.note: cycles are the runner's seeded cohort shaped from the real rotations (deterministic, reproducible); a LIVE wall-clock canary is the stricter alternative and stays available to the operator before sign-off

policy_floor.note: Seeded cycles do NOT satisfy the 24h floor; hours_run counts live operation only
policy_floor.cycle_cadence: 1 cycle = 1 rotation; the 50 seeded cycles stand in for the cycle count only — the 24h floor needs live hours

thresholds.net_in_band: net within the prior band scaled by applied cycles

prior_attempt_tonight.outcome: rolled_back — hit rate drift -0.447 > 0.10 (the drill-proven rollback path fired for real)

rollback_authority: anyone on call, any time, no approval — ops/canary_enable.py --off

signoff.required: Ops AND Product, one named human each
signoff.rule: No sign-off, no full fleet; the dial is the gate between canary and full. A temporary dial state is NOT a deployment — full fleet rides a gated commit.
